rationale: A massive 8.7M-share volume surge in the fourth candle (vs. ~20K–32K in prior bars) drove price sharply from $68.80 to $68.84, with the subsequent candle continuing to $68.91 and pressing within $0.01 of today's high — a classic high-volume absorption/breakout pattern with price holding well above both session VWAP ($68.65) and 9-EMA ($68.72). The prior-day high of $69.06 provides a clear upside target, while positive broad market context (SPY +0.95%) and 4.45x relative volume support directional momentum. Stop is placed just below session VWAP to invalidate the thesis if price fails to hold the breakout structure.
